feasible_loops.reason: existing MP4s can be scored by TRIBE, V-JEPA, and committed CLIP summaries without generating new pixels
selection can operate on candidate pools after generation, while keeping proxy-only language
do not treat prompt rewrites as pixel-affecting unless the generator is prompt-conditioned in that runner
requires a generator path where latent, noise, guidance, or conditioning changes actually affect MP4 pixels

launch_blockers: No local artifact blocker for this dry run; scientific overclaiming gates still apply.
relation_to_content_pocket_validation: The frozen 24-task set is used here only as an existing target for a no-generation proxy-agreement dry run. It remains separate from the manual MP4 screening, hosted-video, forced-choice, and measured-BMD validation lane.

reward_components.differentiability: black-box scalar unless the full TRIBE/BMD scorer is wired into a differentiable generator loop
reward_components.name: tribe_bmd_projection
reward_components.overclaiming_guard: proxy for the model projection only; not human memorability
reward_components.role_in_dry_run: higher raw replay projection selects the side

reward_components.differentiability: black-box embedding scorer for current use; differentiable only inside a separately supported model pipeline
reward_components.name: vjepa_centroid_margin
reward_components.overclaiming_guard: representation agreement signal only; not a validated reward model
reward_components.role_in_dry_run: positive-minus-control centroid margin within each analysis tier

reward_components.differentiability: black-box embedding similarity in this repo context
reward_components.name: clip_seed_video_preservation
reward_components.overclaiming_guard: preservation/semantic guardrail; can disagree with TRIBE and content-pocket labels
reward_components.role_in_dry_run: higher seed-video CLIP cosine selects the side as a preservation guardrail

reward_components.differentiability: inherits black-box status of component scorers
reward_components.formula: z(TRIBE) + 0.5*z(V-JEPA centroid margin) + 0.25*z(CLIP seed-video preservation), z-scored within tier
reward_components.name: composite_proxy_score
reward_components.overclaiming_guard: candidate-selection heuristic only; no validation claim
reward_components.role_in_dry_run: illustrates whether a simple composite would rerank existing candidates differently

smallest_safe_next_spike: Run this proxy-only scorer on a larger generated candidate batch with held-out naming and no human-validation language.
Review disagreement cases where CLIP preservation picks controls but TRIBE/V-JEPA pick content-pocket candidates.
Only after proxy behavior is documented, decide whether a new candidate-generation batch is worth human or measured-BMD evaluation.
stop_rules: Stop if the task is framed as proving human memorability or replacing human/BMD validation.
Stop if the frozen 24-task content-pocket stimulus set would be edited by a proxy experiment.
Stop if prompt text is varied in a runner where prompt text does not affect generated pixels.
Stop if V-JEPA, CLIP, saliency, or TRIBE outputs are described as validated human reward models.
Stop before launch if MP4s, V-JEPA features, or visual-gate statuses are missing for the intended candidate pool.
